title: In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027, improper verification of…
description: A vulnerability in In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027 allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass digital signature validation. The flaw involves improper verification of cryptographic signatures and certificate validation in RadPdfProcessing, enabling forged PDF content to be reported as unmodified with a valid signing certificate.
